subject: ggvis + shiny + dplyr issue with grouped data frames

messages.author: 64ad306a7a60d950
messages.subject: ggvis + shiny + dplyr issue with grouped data frames
parts:
Not sure if it's better to post this on the ggvis, shiny or dplyr group but there's an issue right now with grouped data.  I have a shiny app that has a reactive data frame.  Initially the data frame is empty and contains some place holders.  Upon clicking an actionbutton this dataframe is now populated with data.  The issue is that when you group the populated dataframe, ggvis seems to still want to plot the unpopulated dataframe.  It will plot correctly if you simply remove the group_by statement or pipe in ungroup().  Although the fix is easy in the following example, some plots might require a group_by statement and this problem would be an issue.

The following is a reproducible example:

#server.R
library(shiny)
library(ggvis)
library(dplyr)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {  
  rct_get_df = reactive({
    #placeholder for empty data
    df = data.frame(state = "none", potency = 0, weight = 0, month = 0, price = 0)
    
    #real data
    if(input$data1 > 0) df = cocaine %>% filter(weight > 50) %>% group_by(state) #%>% ungroup()
    #if you remove the group_by or add ungroup() to the above line it will display the plot properly

    df
  })
  
  rct_get_df %>% 
    ggvis(x = ~potency, y = ~weight) %>% 
    layer_points(fill = ~state) %>%
    bind_shiny("ggvis")
})

#ui.R
library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  mainPanel(
    actionButton("data1", "Get Data!"),
    ggvisOutput("ggvis")
  )
))
